skill_name: Write a travelogue about your experience in the city.
workflow: After months of anticipation, I finally got to experience the City of Lights! I was mesmerized by the beauty of the Eiffel Tower and enjoyed a relaxing stroll along the Seine. I spent an afternoon in Montmartre taking in the vibrant atmosphere, and later visited the Louvre to appreciate the array of artworks. I also found the intricacy of Notre Dame Cathedral's gothic architecture a sight to behold. But I think the most enjoyable part of my trip was just walking around old Paris and sightseeing
